parole.significato: earlier; before; sooner; previously; formerly; beforehand (at an earlier time)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Spanish antes, from ante with the adverbial -s, the former from Proto-Indo-European *h₂énti.
From Ancient Greek θερμός (thermós, “warm, hot”) + -ico, from Proto-Indo-European *gʷʰer- (“to heat, warm”).
